claim_text: He prays that those who stole money will be in trouble, that the house of America is being cleaned, and that they will have just a short little window for a major revival, calling in unsaved loved ones from the north, south, east and west.
quote: we will have just a short little window for a major revival
falsify_match: A measurable national turning to church attendance within a few years of this word.
falsify_miss: No turning. A short window with no start and no end cannot expire, and he has used the window framing since 2023 with the length changing each time.

claim_text: He prays over the exposing of things in Cuba, says drug and sex trafficking comes out of Cuba, Venezuela and Mexico and the Lord will end it, and calls for Claudia to be removed and a God fearing government put in over Mexico.
quote: I call for Claudia to be removed
falsify_match: The Mexican president leaves office before the end of her term.
falsify_miss: She serves out her term to 2030. Prayer form gives the usual exit, since an unanswered prayer is not counted as a failed word, but naming a sitting head of state is a real commitment.

claim_text: He prays that Claudia day is coming just as Maduro day came, that a good government be put in over Mexico soon with great revival from the top down, and that Colombia government be exposed over the coca plants.
quote: that they would put a good government in Mexico for the for the Mexican people
falsify_match: A change of government in Mexico and a corruption scandal breaking over the Colombian government.
falsify_miss: Neither. The comparison to Maduro is what gives this a shape, since that removal had just happened and he is projecting it sideways onto a neighbouring country with a very different position.

claim_text: He declares that China will not take Taiwan and it will not be allowed in the spirit realm, tells Xi to bow his knee and release his people, and calls Taiwan to stay free of communist government with a mighty move of God.
quote: We call protection over Taiwan today in Jesus' name
falsify_match: Taiwan remains free and no invasion comes.
falsify_miss: China takes Taiwan. This is the prayer that runs directly against his own repeated word that Taiwan falls in two or three days, and he keeps both: if it falls the word landed, and if it does not the prayer worked.

claim_text: He hears that it is billions in enrichment and minerals in the land, says this is what the president is after and it is not about national security but about enriching America, and sees bribery and strong-arming while they are being stubborn.
quote: it's billions in enrichment and minerals. It's in the land
falsify_match: A minerals agreement over Greenland concluded on American terms.
falsify_miss: No agreement. Greenland rare earth deposits and American interest in them were widely reported through 2025, so the motive is not news; the bribery and the strong-arming are the parts that would have to surface.

claim_text: He saw their flag joining up with the American flag while keeping their own, starting to become part of America, but with much resistance from the elders and older people.
quote: I saw their flag joining up with our flag
falsify_match: Greenland enters a formal association with the United States while keeping its own flag.
falsify_miss: No change in status. He gives the resistance and the joining in the same breath, which lets either outcome be read as what he saw.

claim_text: He says he does not see that they will do this, that it is just chatter and there will be a lot of it, because the elders resist and there are too many of them against the young, though the offer is enticing at about twenty five thousand dollars a year as a change to stipends.
quote: I don't see that they will do this. It's just chatter
falsify_match: Greenland declines the American offer, with the vote or the negotiation failing on generational lines.
falsify_miss: Greenland accepts. Note the figure moves between tellings: twenty five thousand dollars a year as a stipend here on 8 January, and over twenty thousand dollars per citizen as a one off on 13 January. Both cannot be the same offer.

claim_text: He sees Europe and the EU influencing them to say no, with Macron a big loud no, the man over England saying no, and France, Germany and Italy the strongest voices against it.
quote: I see Europe influencing them to say no
falsify_match: Named European leaders publicly opposing an American move on Greenland.
falsify_miss: European opposition to American designs on Greenland was already on the record from January 2025, when France and Germany both said so publicly, so this describes a position that existed a year before the word.

claim_text: He describes the European refusal as a strong arm piece concerning Ukraine, with the question put as why should we help you.
quote: This is like a strong arm piece concerning Ukraine
falsify_match: Reporting that Greenland was traded against European support for Ukraine in a negotiation.
falsify_miss: No such linkage emerges. This is the second half of the same passage and adds the motive rather than a new event; a private linkage between two files is not usually documented.

claim_text: Greenland is being used as a pawn piece to negotiate with Ukraine while the Greenland people have no say, and he states plainly that this is just him talking and he does not understand why Macron would have any say over what Greenland does.
quote: Trying to use Greenland as a pawn piece for trying to negotiate with Ukraine
falsify_match: Documentation that Greenland was used as leverage in the Ukraine negotiation.
falsify_miss: Nothing emerges. He flags this one himself as him talking rather than a word, and says he does not understand what he is seeing, which is the clearest hedge he gives in this session.

claim_text: He says all these nations and their uprisings are getting in line for the Antichrist, but that all he is after is minerals, big money in something in the ground, huge mining pits, wanted for something they are going to do in America.
quote: all he's after is minerals. I see the it's big bucks and minerals
falsify_match: Large scale mining begun in Greenland supplying an American programme.
falsify_miss: No mining begins. Greenland mining projects have repeatedly stalled on permitting and cost, so the base rate for huge pits within a few years is low; he also cannot name the mineral, which he says himself.

claim_text: He says the minerals are not for the golden dome but to back the dollar and make it stronger, that soon it will be Cuba and he will take Cuba and set a proxy government again, all beneficial to the United States, strong-arming alliances the way BRICS does.
quote: Soon it will be Cuba. He'll take Cuba
falsify_match: American action against Cuba followed by an installed government, in the months after this word.
falsify_miss: No action against Cuba. Soon has no length, and backing the dollar with minerals is not a mechanism that exists, which is the weakest part of the passage.

claim_text: A major wealth transfer is about to be seen in Israel and in the Mediterranean outside it: gas rights, oil and major wealth in Gaza, with reserves beyond comprehension under the land and the development of Gaza to be heard about.
quote: It's gas rights, oil, major wealth in the Gaza
falsify_match: Commercial development of gas or oil off Gaza announced with figures attached.
falsify_miss: No development. The Gaza Marine gas field has been known since 2000 and was in the news through 2023 and 2024, so the existence of offshore gas is not a prediction; the scale and the development are what he adds.

claim_text: They will set up a major base in Venezuela in the days ahead, an Air Force and Army base like the one in Iraq, the size of a town, with the oil wells secured so they are not blown up and the economy destroyed.
quote: They'll set up a major base in Venezuela in the days ahead
falsify_match: Construction of a permanent American base in Venezuela, reported after 8 January 2026.
falsify_miss: No base. This is the third telling of the base in a week and the most specific: an Air Force and Army installation the size of a town, which would be impossible to hide and so can fail cleanly.

claim_text: He sees Marines and army in fatigues with guns watching over and protecting the oil wells of Venezuela from the cartel.
quote: Protecting the oil wells of Venezuela from cartel
falsify_match: American troops deployed to guard Venezuelan oil infrastructure against cartel attack.
falsify_miss: No such deployment. It follows naturally from the base claim rather than adding an independent test, and cartel attacks on the wells have not been reported.

claim_text: A major revival springs out of Venezuela, yellow and tropical like new spring flowers; corruption remains in every layer of government but will be weeded out a little at a time.
quote: This is going to spring forth a major revival out of Venezuela
falsify_match: A documented revival movement in Venezuela following the change of government.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable. A little at a time removes any threshold, so slow or no progress reads the same, and the yellow flowers have no referent he can name.

claim_text: He says the administration will never change everything because the bondage is a way of thinking, like Egypt having to come out of Israel over forty years, and that the church has a window for revival before they go back to it.
quote: Israel was free but they were still bound by Egypt. Mentally. 40 years
falsify_match: Nothing to match: this is a caveat on the revival claim rather than a claim of its own.
falsify_miss: It is worth recording because it is the escape clause attached to the Venezuela revival: if no revival comes it can be attributed to the way the people think rather than to the word being wrong.

claim_text: He explains that Australians usually watch because he goes live late, and that the Lord told him to start going on earlier around seven or eight so Americans can pray.
quote: the Lord said Brandon I want you to start going on earlier
falsify_match: Nothing to match: an instruction about broadcast times.
falsify_miss: No claim about the world. Recorded because it is a word attributed to the Lord about his own schedule, which shows how wide the attribution runs.

claim_text: Among the good things he sees: the plague coming, major earthquakes in California, a major revival in Hollywood, and the pornography industry struggling because people stop looking at it.
quote: I saw the porn industry struggling because people doesn't wasn't looking at trash
falsify_match: A reported downturn in the pornography industry alongside a revival movement in Hollywood.
falsify_miss: No downturn. Industry revenue figures exist but are not reliably published, so struggling has no threshold; he also gives no date.

claim_text: He says the fish coming up from the depths that have never been seen before is a major sign the Lord gave, and points at a video his son showed him as evidence it is already happening.
quote: when you start seeing fish coming up out of the depth of the water
falsify_match: Deep sea fish strandings followed by the eruption or quake he attaches them to.
falsify_miss: The sign appears without the event. He treats a viral fish video as confirmation the same day, which is the sign being scored before the thing it was meant to signal; oarfish strandings on the Pacific coast are reported every few years.

claim_text: He notes the fish video had over half a million views, says there should be an alert inside people, then says he saw Japan being split, and that two of the Supreme Court shall step down.
quote: Then I saw Japan being split
falsify_match: Two Supreme Court justices leave the bench, by retirement or otherwise, after 6 January 2026.
falsify_miss: Fewer or more than two go. A count of two is checkable and public, which makes this one of the cleaner claims in the session; the Japan half is the long standing splitting vision with no date.

claim_text: He says they are holding their cards waiting for the president to be done with his turn, and that he saw America trying a regime change in Venezuela to get rid of the man with the slicked back black hair the same way they did Saddam, and that it is oil.
quote: I saw America trying to have a regime change in Venezuela
falsify_match: An American backed change of government in Caracas, on the Iraq pattern.
falsify_miss: No regime change. Said on 3 January, the day after the American strikes, so the operation was already under way when he said it; the Saddam comparison is the part that must still play out.

claim_text: Venezuela looked jungly and tropical with a demonic layer of witchcraft across the nation suppressing the people, and when he saw the leader face he saw Saddam, the two paired like twins in the spirit; an escalation of war is at the shore.
quote: it had a demonic layer across the nation with witchcraft and it suppressed the people
falsify_match: A war escalating out of Venezuela, and a documented change in the occult practice there.
falsify_miss: No escalation. A demonic layer over a nation has no observable form, so only the escalation of war is scoreable, and he hedges that by saying he does not know if there is a lot of occult there.

claim_text: He calls it a game of chess over how to stay the world reserve currency, with strategic allies going to Russia and the BRICS getting stronger, and asks what backs BRICS, answering that Venezuela has the oil.
quote: Strategic allies to Russia with the bricks. Bricks get stronger
falsify_match: BRICS growing into a settlement bloc backed by Venezuelan oil.
falsify_miss: BRICS stalls. He marks the reasoning as his own here, working out the motive rather than reporting a vision, which is the honest form and should be scored as commentary.

claim_text: He keeps seeing massive oil rigs around Venezuela and says the plan is a destabilization of the dollar, not just drugs or trafficking, the same with Kim, whom they do not push too hard because he is a crazy rocket man, and it is all about surrounding the strategic allies of BRICS.
quote: A destabilization of the dollar is what they plan to do
falsify_match: A concerted move by BRICS states away from dollar settlement that measurably weakens it.
falsify_miss: The dollar share of reserves has drifted slowly for two decades without a break, so a small decline would not distinguish this; a genuine destabilization would be unmistakable and has not come.

claim_text: He says the devil visits those who preach that Jesus is coming, and that this is what is coming with Venezuela: the removal of dictators and drug lords because a revival is about to break forth, with the darkness of witchcraft over the land parted.
quote: He's removing dictators and drug lords because a revival is about to break forth
falsify_match: A revival movement in Venezuela reported after the change of government.
falsify_miss: None comes. About to break forth has no window; the removal half had already happened the day before he said this, which is the part he is reading backwards.

claim_text: A great revival breaks forth in Venezuela and spreads throughout Brazil and all of South America, with the Lord saying he will pour out his spirit on those people, then move mightily in Iran with a parting there, then in North Korea.
quote: it was spreads all throughout Brazil and all throughout South America
falsify_match: A documented continent wide revival across South America following January 2026.
falsify_miss: Evangelical growth across Brazil and South America has been documented for decades, so the trend was running before the word and any figure could be read as the match.

claim_text: The Lord says he will shake North Korea and get rid of it, and that he will remove two dictators; he saw Kim Jong-un go home and go to hell, and his sister too, with liberation for the people of North Korea in the days ahead.
quote: I'm going to remove two dictators, Brandon
falsify_match: Kim Jong-un and Kim Yo-jong both removed from power.
falsify_miss: Both remain. Two dictators is a count that can fail, and the claim has been repeated since January 2025 with nothing behind it; in the days ahead gives it no end.

claim_text: The North Korean army tries to suppress it and China comes in, but the Lord says he is giving them a window of opportunity; he saw people teleported and a superhighway above the atmosphere like spaghetti noodles, with people put in to bring liberation.
quote: And a superhighway above the atmosphere. Look like spaghetti noodles
falsify_match: Reported instances of people appearing where they could not have travelled.
falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind is documented. Teleportation has no evidential form that could be checked, so this scores as unfalsifiable however North Korea turns out.

claim_text: He describes the prince of Persia and the angel holding Iraq, says the Lord is bringing liberation to Iraq and that the Iraqi dinar would go up in value in the days ahead, and that he saw the number 25.
quote: Iraqi dinar would go up in value in the days ahead
falsify_match: A revaluation of the Iraqi dinar, with the number 25 appearing in the rate.
falsify_miss: The dinar has held its peg near 1310 to the dollar and no revaluation has come. He has been saying this since 2023 and the number 25 is offered without saying what it counts, which is what keeps it alive.

claim_text: He saw the grip loosed and three people over the Central Bank of Iraq with major things taking place there because Iran had such a hold on Iraq, and says plainly this is just him praying into what the Lord has shown over time.
quote: I saw three people over the Central Bank of Iraq
falsify_match: Three named officials at the Central Bank of Iraq removed or exposed.
falsify_miss: Nothing happens there. A count of three is checkable, but he hedges the whole passage as his own praying rather than a word, which is how it would be excused if nothing follows.

claim_text: He says what is coming is a COVID on steroids that makes COVID look like a cakewalk, a great acceleration of wars, and a major taking over of Taiwan: they circled Taiwan and took it in three days while America was too busy with a wound inside.
quote: They were circling Taiwan and they took Taiwan in 3 days
falsify_match: China takes Taiwan in three days while America is occupied by a domestic crisis.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or a longer campaign. This is the three day form on 3 January, against his own two day telling from June 2025, and the two are kept side by side rather than reconciled; the linkage to an American wound is the falsifiable part, since it requires both events at once.

claim_text: Some kind of cyber or major event takes place in America, and he keeps seeing a red dawn D-Day experience in the country; the Lord says that because of the Biden administration they have infiltrated the borders and are in the country now, and will try to roll out through the 250th anniversary to bring havoc.
quote: they have infiltrated your borders and they are in your country as we speak
falsify_match: A coordinated attack inside America around the 250th anniversary in 2026.
falsify_miss: The anniversary passes without an attack. This is the dated form of the red dawn thread and it does expire, on 4 July 2026 or at latest the end of the anniversary year, which makes it stronger than the undated tellings.

claim_text: He saw that Macron is an Ishmael to the Isaac of what is coming, not the Antichrist but he will look like it in the days ahead; and he saw the president sailing a boat with a storm all around him, with the Lord saying they will be thankful that man is president.
quote: Emmanuel Macron was an Ishmael to to the Isaac of what will come
falsify_match: Macron taking a role in Europe that is widely read as antichrist-like.
falsify_miss: He leaves office in 2027 without any such role. Not the Antichrist but will look like it is a claim built so that either outcome fits: prominence confirms it and obscurity confirms he was never the real one.

claim_text: He saw him trying to flee with a hundred million dollars in cash in a plane, having stolen taxpayer money, and twenty four billion dollars of corrupted money funnelled through corrupt politician accounts, tied back to the bees out of the ground in Minnesota and a red wave.
quote: I saw 24 billion dollars that it was corrupted money through politicians
falsify_match: A leader fleeing with a hundred million in cash, and a twenty four billion dollar funnelling scandal charged.
falsify_miss: Neither. The hundred million and the twenty four billion are both specific enough to fail, and nothing of the kind had surfaced through August 2026.

claim_text: Her political career ends abruptly with new people coming in, the same happens in California with a great revival there, a shaking to awaken Portland with a major earthquake, buildings in British Columbia crumbling completely, thirty five thousand people dead there within a couple of hours and a wave of water coming in.
quote: I saw 35,000 people pass away in British Columbia within just a couple of hours
falsify_match: A major Cascadia earthquake off British Columbia with a death toll near thirty five thousand and a tsunami.
falsify_miss: No quake. The toll moves between tellings: thirty thousand in the earlier version and thirty five thousand here, which is a discrepancy in the one number that would ever be checked.

claim_text: As a sign of what is about to happen, activity comes out in the middle of the water and volcanoes in the middle of the ocean begin to be active; he says to watch these for they will be a sign, and saw major earthquakes in the Pacific, with China doing things at the Panama Canal.
quote: Volcanoes in the middle of the ocean will start to begin active
falsify_match: Submarine volcanic activity followed by major Pacific earthquakes.
falsify_miss: Submarine eruptions happen continuously and are detected most years, so the sign has a base rate near certainty and would be claimed whatever follows.

claim_text: God will bring revival to those people with many saved and delivered, and he says days of great fun have just begun, but that shaking comes to America because great pride has set in and the Lord will humble the people, followed by a great revival in America.
quote: great pride has set in. He said I'm going to humble them
falsify_match: A national reversal read as a humbling, followed by a documented revival.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinctive. Humbling and shaking have no thresholds, and pairing them with revival means both good and bad outcomes confirm the word.

claim_text: He says he is honoured to be invited to speak at churches, notes the time on the East Coast, counts the audience at about three thousand five hundred, and greets viewers in Europe, Spain and England.
quote: I guess we're talking to Europe right now, right?
falsify_match: Nothing to match: audience housekeeping.
falsify_miss: No claim about the world; the place names are what put it in the queue.

claim_text: He says the number one thing to pray is that America does not give Tomahawk missiles to Zelensky, because he saw them poking the bear by shooting at the Kremlin and a weapon of mass destruction used on Poland that wiped out a lot of people, and Putin did it.
quote: a weapon of mass destruction that will be used on Poland in the days ahead
falsify_match: A weapon of mass destruction used by Russia on Polish territory.
falsify_miss: No such strike. A Russian WMD strike on a NATO member has a very low base rate, so this would be worth a great deal if it landed; the prayer framing supplies the exit if it does not, since the missiles can be said not to have been given.

claim_text: He thanks the European audience, asks them to like and subscribe, and says he will try to get up earlier and do more prayer videos because he sees more at night.
quote: I'll try to get up earlier and and and do more prayer videos
falsify_match: Nothing to match: a sign off.
falsify_miss: No claim. He does say he sees more at night, which is a statement about his own practice rather than about the world.

claim_text: In the middle of prayer he asks why he is seeing Cuba and why he keeps seeing Cuba.
quote: Why am I seeing Cuba? Why do I keep seeing Cuba?
falsify_match: Nothing to match: a name with no event attached.
falsify_miss: Recorded because it is the earliest stirring of the Cuba thread, in July 2025, six months before the Cuba material that fills January 2026. On its own it predicts nothing.

claim_text: He sees the new Canadian prime minister, connected heavily to Europe, and praying into the Catholic Church sees him standing out with the king, the man from Canada, the prime minister of Germany and Macron.
quote: I see their their prime minister man, that that the guy the new guy
falsify_match: A visible alignment of the Canadian prime minister, the German chancellor, Macron, the King and the Vatican on a shared policy.
falsify_miss: No such grouping forms. G7 leaders meet routinely and the Pope speaks on world affairs, so seeing them together is not a prediction; the shared plan is what would have to be shown.

claim_text: He sees Zelensky, and the Pope, the man over Canada, Macron, Germany and the king of England, and says he sees war around Zelensky, war in Ukraine, war.
quote: I see war around Lozinsky. I see Ukraine
falsify_match: The Pope taking a visible hand in Ukraine decisions alongside those leaders.
falsify_miss: No Vatican role emerges. The war in Ukraine was three years old when he said this, so seeing war around Zelensky costs nothing; only the Vatican involvement is a claim.

claim_text: He sees them in Canada and England devising a plan and asking how they sustain this, with the Pope involved, and says he does not understand why the Pope would be in it, and sees Germany.
quote: their their devising a plan. How do we sustain this?
falsify_match: Evidence that European governments prolonged the war for economic reasons.
falsify_miss: No evidence. How do we sustain this is his own reading of a motive, and he says he does not understand why the Pope would be part of it, which is a hedge on the whole passage.
